text: １５ねん　まえ　なら　わたしが　かって　いた　だろう！

structure.jp: わたしが　かって　いた　だろう！

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a word means 'if it were that'. １５ねん まえ なら = 'if it were fifteen years ago'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.span: かって　いた　だろう
patterns.explanation: だろう at the end makes a confident guess: 'probably' or 'surely'. かって いた だろう = 'I would have won'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ていた after 'if' pictures how things would have ended up. かって いた = 'would have won'.
